title: ORACLE-6 Trend Intelligence Signal — SCS-001 Mock Contract
description: Contract between Voxight ORACLE-6 feed and SCS-001 Trend Agent. Defines the Intelligence Signal object schema that the Trend Agent consumes. Build against this mock until Phase 2B gate (live ORACLE-6 switch). Derived from AMD-05 + SCS-001 Charter Article III Agent 1.

query_type.description: Voxight query type that produced this signal

topic.description: Detected trending topic name. Max 120 chars.

summary.description: One-paragraph summary of the signal. Max 500 chars.

confidence.description: Signal confidence score 0-100. Trend Agent gate: only topics with confidence >= 60 enter the Discovery Agent queue.

keyword_cluster.description: Related keywords/phrases for this topic. Used by Discovery Agent for video search.

top_speakers.description: Key voices driving this topic. Used by Discovery Agent for source prioritisation.

relevant_channels.description: Channels where this topic is being discussed. Discovery Agent uses these as search targets.

source.description: Where the signal originated. 'voxight_module_2' is the primary source when live. Others are fallback.

first_seen.description: Earliest detection of this topic in the signal stream

mainstream_eta_days.description: Estimated days until this topic reaches mainstream TikTok visibility. Voxight edge target: 14-28 days.

provenance.description: Signal provenance — tracks where and how the signal was detected. Critical for the Kognai edge (2-4 week lead).

domain_tags.description: SCS-001 domain scope tags (Charter Article II). Signals outside these domains are dropped.

scs_relevant.description: Whether this signal is relevant to SCS-001's domain scope. Pre-filtered by Voxight. Trend Agent may override.
